surface: Admin Console — accessibilite NF525 (replay transaction / qui-a-modifie / archive 6 ans / Z-report reimpression / chain verify / audit_logs search)
perspective: Inspecteur des finances publiques (DGFiP / control fiscal France) arrive a froid sur le tablette d'un manager Le Cayenne. Il doit, sans CLI, sans dev, sans aller en base : (1) rejouer une transaction historique completee avec composition_snapshot + payment trail + fiscal_sequence_no + audit_chain hash, (2) tracer qui a modifie quoi (audit_logs UI lisible), (3) exporter l'archive NF525 6 ans pour une periode/branche, (4) reimprimer le Z-report d'un jour passe (et son PDF signe), (5) lancer la verification de chaine HMAC audit_logs+z_reports a la demande, (6) chercher par date/caissier/commande dans audit_logs. Question fondamentale : un controle fiscal sans dev-en-renfort est-il faisable en V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL ?
scope: READ-ONLY audit. Mapping app/Services/Fiscal/* + app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Fiscal/* + app/Console/Commands/Fiscal*Command.php + resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/{AuditTrailComponent,LastZReportWidget}.vue + resources/js/components/admin/transactions/TransactionListComponent.vue + resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderShowComponent.vue + resources/js/router/modules/*.js + routes/api.php (fiscal prefix). Cross-checked against CLAUDE.md SS8 NF525 invariants and the 2x existing CLI commands FiscalVerifyChainCommand + FiscalArchiveCommand.

inspector_question_1_replay_one_transact.what_he_needs: Click on a past order, see its (a) order_serial_no + fiscal_sequence_no + branch_id, (b) full composition_snapshot (sealed JSON: items + options + prices at the moment of payment, NEVER recomputed), (c) audit chain context — prev_hash, current_hash on the audit_logs row for that order + which Z-report sealed it (z_reports.id), (d) full payment breakdown (cash/card/TR + TPE transaction_id + idempotency_key), (e) ability to print a DUPLICATA fiscal-stamped ticket on demand. This is the single most important capability — every NF525 control begins with 'show me order X'.
inspector_question_1_replay_one_transact.what_exists_backend: OrderDetailsResource.php builds an audit_fingerprint (lines 110-131, 12-char hex derived from current_hash). composition_snapshot is sealed at order creation per CLAUDE.md SS8 and stored in orders table. Payments retrievable via order->payments() relation. PosReceiptPrintController emits 'pos.receipt.reprint' audit row when receipt_print_count >= 2. ZReportController::show returns a signed JSON bundle. EVERY backend primitive needed is in place.
inspector_question_1_replay_one_transact.what_exists_ui: PosOrderShowComponent.vue (admin/posOrders/PosOrderShowComponent.vue) shows order_serial_no, status, payment_type, order_type, table_name, order items with quantity+image+name+price, plus a single 'Print invoice' button (line 172, v-print=printObj — a generic vue3-print-nb HTML print, NOT the fiscal duplicata endpoint). NO fiscal_sequence_no displayed. NO audit_fingerprint displayed. NO link to which Z-report sealed this order. NO composition_snapshot drill-down (the sealed JSON is invisible). NO 'reimprimer ticket fiscal' button calling admin/pos/orders/{order}/print-receipt (the duplicata-aware endpoint). NO idempotency_key / TPE transaction_id displayed.
inspector_question_1_replay_one_transact.gap_severity: P0 — the inspector cannot reconstruct any past transaction from the admin UI alone. He must request a dev to run `php artisan tinker` and re-query Order::with('payments')->find(N), then manually JSON-encode composition_snapshot, then SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE resource='order' AND resource_id=N to fetch the chain context. The frontend ABSOLUTELY exposes none of this. The audit_fingerprint computed in OrderDetailsResource is ORPHAN — no admin Vue consumer reads `data.audit_fingerprint` (grep audit_fingerprint resources/js returns ZERO consumers; only i18n key 'label.audit_fingerprint' exists in fr.json but is never bound).

inspector_question_2_who_modified_what_a.what_he_needs: A filterable table over the NF525 hash-chained `audit_logs` table (not the loose ActionLog!) with at minimum : user_id+name, action (e.g. 'pos.receipt.reprint', 'order.cancelled', 'payment.collected', 'discount.applied'), resource+resource_id (clickable to drill into the order), branch_id, ip+user_agent (already stored — see AuditLog::fillable lines 20-32), timestamp, chain context (prev_hash/current_hash truncated). Filters : date range, action type, user, branch, resource type, resource_id. Pagination. Export CSV/PDF.
inspector_question_2_who_modified_what_a.what_exists_backend: AuditLog model (app/Models/AuditLog.php) is INSERT-only with double DB-trigger + Eloquent boot guards. All NF525-relevant writes go through AuditLogService::write — verified at OrderService.php 20+ call sites, PaymentService.php 4+ call sites, PosReceiptPrintController. The fields ip, user_agent, session_id, payload (JSON) are all persisted (AuditLog.php:29-32). The table holds the inspector's gold-standard evidence.
inspector_question_2_who_modified_what_a.what_exists_ui: Dashboard widget AuditTrailComponent.vue (resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/AuditTrailComponent.vue) mounted on /admin/dashboard. But the controller it calls — DashboardController::auditTrail (line 178) — delegates to DashboardService::auditTrail (lines 514-549) which reads `App\Models\ActionLog`, NOT `App\Models\AuditLog`. ActionLog is a SEPARATE, NON-HASH-CHAINED table (app/Models/ActionLog.php — no INSERT-only guard, no prev_hash/current_hash columns) used for general application actions. **The 'Audit Trail' widget shown to admins is NOT the NF525 audit_logs table. It is a parallel non-fiscal log.** Beyond that widget : there is NO Vue/route/controller pair anywhere in resources/js or routes/api.php that surfaces the real `audit_logs` table to the admin UI. Verified : grep `AuditLog::|App\\Models\\AuditLog\b` across app/Http/ returns exactly ONE hit (OrderDetailsResource.php for the truncated fingerprint), zero hits in routes/, zero hits in resources/js/.
inspector_question_2_who_modified_what_a.gap_severity: P0 — the inspector asking 'who reprinted ticket 11842 last Tuesday?' cannot get the answer from the admin UI. The data exists in audit_logs but is reachable ONLY by raw SQL. The Dashboard 'Audit Trail (Historique des Actions)' card actively MISLEADS — it carries an i18n label suggesting fiscal trail but exposes a non-chained, non-NF525-validated log. This is the inspector-confusion vector and the V1 LOCAL admin-only gap most likely to surface during a real control.

inspector_question_3_export_nf525_archiv.what_he_needs: A button : 'Export NF525 archive — branch X, period [from; to]' → produces a signed zip bundle containing manifest.json (with z_chain_verified=true + verify_meta), z_reports.json, orders.json (including soft-deleted per Z6-P1-WGS), audit_logs.json. Bundle must be downloadable from the admin UI (or at least listed if produced by cron) and the manifest must show retention_years=6.
inspector_question_3_export_nf525_archiv.what_exists_backend: FiscalArchiveCommand.php (`php artisan foodking:fiscal:archive <branch_id> --from=YYYY-MM-DD --to=YYYY-MM-DD`) is fully implemented : lazy-cursor streaming, ZipArchive::addFile, ARCHIVE_LOCK_TTL=600s + ARCHIVE_LOCK_WAIT=30s to prevent TOCTOU with concurrent Z open/close, pre-archive verifyChain enforcement (`fiscal.verify_chain_before_archive` config = true by default), 6-year retention recorded in manifest (schema_version=3 with z_chain_verified block per W9.A). Storage disk configurable via `fiscal.archive_disk` + `fiscal.archive_path`.
inspector_question_3_export_nf525_archiv.what_exists_ui: ZERO. No Vue component, no admin route, no router/sidebar entry, no controller endpoint surfaces this. Verified : grep 'fiscal/archive|fiscal-archive|FiscalArchive' across resources/js + routes/ returns zero matches. The only path to generate an archive is SSH-into-the-server + run `php artisan foodking:fiscal:archive`. There is also NO listing endpoint exposing what's already in storage/fiscal/<branch_id>/*.zip — even if a daily cron produces the bundles, the manager cannot see them, list them, download them, or hand them to the inspector without server access.
inspector_question_3_export_nf525_archiv.gap_severity: P0 — NF525 explicitly requires the archive to be producible on demand by the operator during a control. The CLI exists, but a control inspector does NOT have a shell. Required UI is a manager-permission'd page : pick branch, pick period, click Produce → background job → download link surfaces in storage. AND a list of already-produced bundles with their manifest summary.

inspector_question_4_z_report_reprint_pa.what_he_needs: List view of all closed Z-reports for a branch, filterable by date range. Click a row → see Z metadata (sequence_no, opened_at, closed_at, signature, total_cash, total_card, total_tr, audit_chain context). Click 'PDF' → download the signed PDF (NOT just a JSON bundle). Click 'Reprint' → physical paper duplicata.
inspector_question_4_z_report_reprint_pa.what_exists_backend: ZReportController.php exposes : GET /api/admin/fiscal/z-report (list, top 100, admin sees cross-branch) — lines 22-41 ; GET /api/admin/fiscal/z-report/{zReport} (show) — lines 63-71 ; GET /api/admin/fiscal/z-report/{zReport}/pdf — lines 79-95 returns a SIGNED JSON payload with verified flag, BUT NOT a real PDF (comment line 75-77 explicitly says 'actual PDF rendering is delegated to a later view layer'). No PDF blade template found in resources/views/pdf — verified ls resources/views/pdf/. A `fiscal-receipt.blade.php` exists in `.claude/worktrees/blissful-mclean-c915c2/resources/views/pdf/` but NOT in the main tree.
inspector_question_4_z_report_reprint_pa.what_exists_ui: LastZReportWidget.vue (resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/LastZReportWidget.vue) shows ONLY the latest Z-report : sequence_no + status + closed_at date. Click-through goes to `admin.transactions.list` (line 24 router-link to='admin.transactions.list') which is the GENERIC TransactionListComponent (resources/js/components/admin/transactions/TransactionListComponent.vue) — a payment-row listing filtered by transaction_no/order_serial_no/payment_method/date, with NO Z-report rows, NO sequence_no column, NO 'reprint Z' button, NO PDF download. Verified : grep z-report|zReport|fiscal in resources/js/router/modules/ returns only comments in cashSessionReportRoutes.js (mentions Z-report permission reuse) — there is no dedicated /admin/fiscal/z-report route in the Vue router.
inspector_question_4_z_report_reprint_pa.gap_severity: P0 — the inspector asking 'show me the Z of March 17' has no path through the admin UI. The backend list endpoint is reachable (last 100), but no Vue component renders it. The PDF endpoint exists but returns JSON, not PDF — and is unreachable from the UI. The reprint paper-trail (NF525 Article 286-I-3 bis duplicata) is implemented only for individual receipts (PosReceiptPrintController), not for Z-reports.

inspector_question_5_audit_chain_verify_.what_he_needs: A 'Verify NF525 chain integrity NOW' button accessible to managers/admins. Click → spinner → 'CHAIN OK (audit_logs N rows + z_reports M rows, branch=X, verified at T)' OR 'TAMPER DETECTED — audit_logs.id=12345, z_reports.id=789 (signature_mismatch)'. Print/export the verification certificate. This is THE on-the-spot proof of integrity an inspector will ask for.
inspector_question_5_audit_chain_verify_.what_exists_backend: FiscalVerifyChainCommand.php (`php artisan fiscal:verify-chain --branch=N` or `--all`) is comprehensively implemented : walks BOTH audit_logs (via AuditLogService::verifyChain) AND z_reports (via ZReportService::verifyChain) chains, enumerates EVERY breach (chain_break + sequence_gap + signature_mismatch) per Wave 2d FISCAL-ADV3C-02, distinct exit codes 0/1/2/3 for monitoring routing, handles branch-not-found + cred-error + tamper as distinct lanes. The CLI is a textbook NF525 verifier.
inspector_question_5_audit_chain_verify_.what_exists_ui: ZERO. No HTTP endpoint exposes this. Verified : grep 'fiscal/verify|verify-chain' routes/ + resources/ returns zero matches outside the CLI command itself + its tests. The daily 'fiscal-chain-monitor' cron runs but its output goes to log channel 'fiscal' — invisible to managers. There is no admin button, no widget, no badge, no green-check showing 'chain verified at T+N min'.
inspector_question_5_audit_chain_verify_.gap_severity: P0 — a control inspector asks 'prove the chain is intact NOW' and the manager has no clickable answer. The CLI exists with exit codes designed for monitoring, but no monitoring UI consumes those exits in the admin surface. The Z-report widget says nothing about chain validity. Worse : the audit_emitted=false warning emitted at PosReceiptPrintController:73 + ReceiptComponent:554 is a one-shot toast — once dismissed, the manager has no log of chain failures.

inspector_question_6_search_audit_logs_b.what_he_needs: Free-form search over audit_logs : by date range + user_id (cashier) + action type + resource_id (order). 'Show me all writes by user 42 between Mar 14 and Mar 17 on order 11842'. Pagination, CSV export.
inspector_question_6_search_audit_logs_b.what_exists_backend: audit_logs table has the indexes implied by the queries the inspector needs (branch_id+created_at, resource+resource_id — used by OrderDetailsResource::buildAuditFingerprint). FiscalArchiveCommand::auditLogQuery (lines 352-361) demonstrates the query pattern. No dedicated controller endpoint, no resource transformer, no /api/admin/audit-logs route.
inspector_question_6_search_audit_logs_b.what_exists_ui: ZERO. The closest is AuditTrailComponent reading ActionLog (not audit_logs — see Gap 2 above) with no filters, no pagination, just `orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->limit(50)` (DashboardService.php:531-532). No date filter. No cashier filter. No resource_id filter. No drill-through to the originating order.
inspector_question_6_search_audit_logs_b.gap_severity: P0 — the inspector cannot perform any forensic query without dev shell access. Even the most basic 'who acted on order N?' requires raw SQL. Note this gap is compounded by Gap 2 — even if a search UI existed but pointed to ActionLog (the wrong table), it would still mislead.

non_questioned_but_critical_meta_finding.finding: Audit chain failure on receipt reprint is a fire-and-forget toast (alertService.warning at ReceiptComponent.vue:555). If the manager dismisses the toast or is away from the screen, the chain failure is gone from operational view. No persistent admin banner, no dashboard counter, no email/SMS alert to fiscal ops. SIEM is mentioned in the PosReceiptPrintController docstring but no integration is wired in V1 LOCAL.

ZReportController::pdf returns `application/json` containing the signed Z payload + `verified` flag, not a real `application/pdf`. The docstring (lines 73-78) acknowledges 'PDF rendering is delegated to a later view layer'. That layer was never implemented in the main tree (resources/views/pdf has only online_orders/items_report/sales_report blades, no fiscal-receipt.blade.php). NF525 compliance technically allows the JSON+signature path IF the operator can produce it on demand — but the inspector traditionally expects a printable physical PDF, not a JSON dump.

OrderDetailsResource::buildAuditFingerprint (lines 110-131) produces a 12-char hex from the latest audit_logs hash for the order — exactly the inspector-friendly proof. It's wired in the JSON response. But ZERO admin Vue components read `audit_fingerprint` from the response payload. The i18n key `label.audit_fingerprint` exists in fr.json but has no consumer. Orphan capability.

Branch-scoping in DashboardService::auditTrail (lines 524-528) correctly scopes ActionLog by branch for non-admin actors (POS-9-H.1.3 closure of F-A3 cross-tenant leak). But for the NF525 audit_logs table — once a UI is added — the inspector context is BRANCH-WIDE for branch managers and CROSS-BRANCH for admin (branch_id=0 bypass). Mirroring the ZReportController::resolveBranchIdForRead (lines 125-130) pattern for audit_logs UI is the right precedent.

POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE production boot guard (AppServiceProvider.php:78-145 per CLAUDE.md §8) prevents production from running without real fiscal sealing. Good. But there is no operator-facing 'fiscal mode = production / simulation' badge in the admin UI. Manager cannot tell at a glance whether the box is fiscal-armed.

what_already_works_credit: Backend NF525 primitives are textbook : AuditLog model is INSERT-only at both DB-trigger and Eloquent levels; AuditLogService::write is the single SSOT for chain appends; ZReportService::verifyChain returns structured errors; FiscalVerifyChainCommand walks BOTH chains and surfaces distinct exit codes for monitoring; FiscalArchiveCommand streams with lazy cursors + holds branch lock for TOCTOU safety + records z_chain_verified in manifest schema_version 3; soft-deleted orders are INCLUDED in archive per Z6-P1-WGS 2026-05-19 forensic completeness rule.
Cron-side : daily fiscal-chain-monitor (mentioned in FiscalVerifyChainCommand docstring) and Z auto-archival exist via scheduled tasks.

Receipt reprint logic is NF525-faithful : print count atomically incremented, action=`pos.receipt.print` vs `pos.receipt.reprint` (duplicata) distinction, audit chain write best-effort with UI warning on failure (ReceiptComponent.vue:554-556).
audit_fingerprint exposure in OrderDetailsResource is privacy-correct (12-char SHA-256 derivative of current_hash + id, never leaks the raw HMAC). UI just needs to render it.
Branch scoping on the ActionLog 'audit trail' widget correctly handles admin (branch_id=0 cross-branch) vs staff (own branch only) post POS-9-H.1.3.

v1_blocker_v_v1_0_x_breakdown.v1_local_le_cayenne_today_can_pass_a_con: NO — without dev shell access, an inspector cannot replay a transaction, cannot view audit_logs, cannot export an archive, cannot reprint a Z PDF, cannot verify the chain, cannot search. Every single one of his 6 ordinary asks fails.
v1_blocker_v_v1_0_x_breakdown.v1_local_le_cayenne_with_dev_on_site: YES — every CLI + DB query path exists, so a developer can produce evidence in under 30 minutes per control. NF525 itself does not REQUIRE the UI as long as the audit trail + chain exist (which they do). But the operator is dependent on dev availability.
minimal_v1_0_1_uplift_to_make_owner_self: G1 (P0) — Wire audit_fingerprint + fiscal_sequence_no into PosOrderShowComponent header + a 'Reprint duplicata' button calling admin/pos/orders/{order}/print-receipt (the endpoint already exists).

G2 (P0) — Replace AuditTrailComponent.vue's data source : DashboardService::auditTrail should query App\Models\AuditLog (not ActionLog) for branch managers + admin, OR rename the widget to 'Action history (non-fiscal)' and add a SEPARATE 'Fiscal audit chain' widget reading AuditLog. The current label is misleading.

G3 (P0) — Add /admin/fiscal/z-reports route + Vue component listing Z reports with date filter + click-through to existing show endpoint + PDF download (which first requires implementing a real fiscal-receipt.blade.php for the PDF response — currently returns JSON).

G4 (P0) — Add /admin/fiscal/verify-chain admin button → HTTP endpoint wrapping FiscalVerifyChainCommand::handle (run synchronously, return structured result) + UI badge on dashboard showing last-verified-at + last-status.

G5 (P0) — Add /admin/fiscal/archive admin page : pick branch + period → POST kicks off FiscalArchiveCommand as a queued job → download link surfaces once written. + GET listing of already-produced bundles in storage.
G6 (P0) — Add /admin/audit-logs search page reading AuditLog with filters (date, action, user_id, resource_id, branch_id for admin) + paginated table + CSV export.
G7 (P1) — Persistent admin banner / counter when audit_emitted=false toast was raised (track in a small admin_notifications table or extend the existing fiscal log channel + surface in dashboard).
G8 (P1) — 'Fiscal mode = PRODUCTION' badge on admin shell sourced from POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE env so manager visually confirms armed state.
v1_blocker_v_v1_0_x_breakdown.estimated_lift_for_v1_0_1: G1-G6 are mostly thin Vue + thin controller wrappers over existing services. G3's PDF blade is the heaviest item (~2-3 hr). G5's job queue plumbing already exists (Laravel queue is operational per CLAUDE.md §8 IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED + queue config). Reasonable ballpark : 1-2 dev-days for G1-G4 + G6, 0.5 day for G5 + G7-G8. Total ~2-3 dev-days. ZERO frozen-zone touch (none of these UIs ride PaymentComponent.vue or PosV5TrancheRow.vue or pos-wizard.js).

top_3_gaps_ranked.gap: Audit Trail dashboard widget reads ActionLog, NOT the NF525 hash-chained audit_logs. UI MISLEADS the operator and the inspector — a glance suggests fiscal evidence but the table behind it has no prev_hash/current_hash, no INSERT-only guard, no tamper-evidence. The real audit_logs has ZERO admin UI surface in the entire frontend (zero AuditLog reads in resources/js).
top_3_gaps_ranked.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/AuditTrailComponent.vue + app/Services/DashboardService.php:514-549 + app/Models/ActionLog.php (no INSERT-only guard) vs app/Models/AuditLog.php:42-58 (INSERT-only Eloquent boot guard + DB trigger)

top_3_gaps_ranked.gap: FiscalArchiveCommand (NF525 6-year bundle export) and FiscalVerifyChainCommand (on-demand chain verification) are CLI-only. No admin route, no Vue page, no sidebar entry. A control inspector requesting a period archive or a chain-integrity proof during an on-site control forces the operator to call a developer. The backend is comprehensive (lazy cursor, branch lock, z_chain_verified manifest, distinct exit codes 0/1/2/3), but unreachable without shell access.
top_3_gaps_ranked.evidence: app/Console/Commands/FiscalArchiveCommand.php:1-362 + app/Console/Commands/FiscalVerifyChainCommand.php:1-284 vs routes/api.php (no /admin/fiscal/archive, no /admin/fiscal/verify-chain) vs resources/js/router/modules (no archive/verify route)

top_3_gaps_ranked.gap: Past-order replay in PosOrderShowComponent.vue is fiscal-naked. NO fiscal_sequence_no displayed. NO audit_fingerprint displayed (despite OrderDetailsResource::buildAuditFingerprint already computing it). NO link to the Z-report that sealed the order. NO composition_snapshot drill-down. The 'Print invoice' button is a generic vue3-print-nb HTML print, NOT the duplicata-aware admin/pos/orders/{order}/print-receipt endpoint. The inspector cannot verify a single past transaction without raw SQL.
top_3_gaps_ranked.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/posOrders/PosOrderShowComponent.vue:1-340 (no fiscal fields rendered) + app/Http/Resources/OrderDetailsResource.php:110-131 (audit_fingerprint orphan capability) + app/Http/Controllers/Admin/Pos/PosReceiptPrintController.php:35-105 (duplicata endpoint not wired into past-order UI)

verdict.headline: V1 Le Cayenne LOCAL ships with COMPLETE NF525 BACKEND PRIMITIVES but a SHALLOW ADMIN UI for inspector accessibility. A control without on-site developer cannot answer any of the 6 ordinary fiscal inspector questions. The CLI commands fiscal:verify-chain + foodking:fiscal:archive + AuditLog::write are textbook; the surfaces wrapping them are missing.
p0_gaps: audit_logs UI (currently reads wrong table — ActionLog)
p1_gaps: persistent admin alert for audit_emitted=false (currently dismissable toast)
fiscal mode (production vs simulation) badge in admin shell
verdict.ship_v1_today_status: GO for LOCAL Le Cayenne IF owner accepts that a real fiscal control requires dev-on-site (CLI ops). NO-GO for any branch where the operator must be self-sufficient during a control.
verdict.v1_0_1_roadmap_recommendation: Bundle G1-G6 (Vue + thin controllers wrapping existing services + 1 new fiscal-receipt.blade.php) into a 2-3 dev-day 'Inspector Self-Service' wave. Zero frozen-zone touch. Direct CLAUDE.md §8 NF525 invariants strengthening — pure UI surface, no business-logic change. Recommend scheduling immediately after current Wave Polish Final convergence is owner-signed-off.
